item.title: Morgan Wallen’s ‘I’m the Problem’ Back at No. 1 on Billboard 200 for 14th Week
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the latest music update. This week, Morgan Wallen's album "I'm the Problem" is back on top of the Billboard 200 chart for a 14th nonconsecutive week. The album, which has never left the top 10, earned 80,000 equivalent album units in the US, with a 7% increase from the previous week.
[Soft music transitions]
Host: Wallen's recent promotion and publicity around his new song "Been by Now" might have contributed to the album's resurgence. He performed the song live for the first time on July 18th and released it on July 24th. Although the song isn't on the album, it's likely generating buzz around his music.
[Short music break]
Host: This isn't the first time an album has returned to the top spot after a long break. Earlier this year, Bad Bunny's "DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS" also reclaimed the top spot after nearly eight months. "I'm the Problem" was last number one in January, and before that, it spent 12 nonconsecutive weeks at the top.
[Music transitions]
Host: In other news, Charli XCX's new album "Music, Fashion, Film" debuts at number 3 on the Billboard 200 chart, earning 78,000 equivalent album units. This is her largest debut week and fourth top 10 album. Olivia Rodrigo's "you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love" remains at number 2, with just under 80,000 equivalent album units earned.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's the latest from the music world. For more chart updates and news, follow @billboard and @billboardcharts on social media. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next update! [Outro music continues to play until the end]
